notes: chi(psi (x) phi) >= chi(psi) when phi has a nonzero computational amplitude, applied to chi(S^5) >= 5, whose certificate prints this line as well. Puts the cell at 5 <= chi <= 8; the m=6 upper bound is the Lean tensor cube of the two-copy witness.
